selection: validation only: fewest unsafe steps, highest comfort, lowest energy, highest reward

validation.baseline: HVAC heat below 20 C, cool above 24 C; ventilation above 1000 ppm CO2; purifier above 12 ug/m3 PM2.5; humidity target 40-60%; clean above 30% dirt. Shared lighting, blinds, security, sleep and final safety rules.
validation.method: Paired closed-loop simulation: identical initial states, weather, seeded physics/occupancy noise; 10-minute steps. Both controllers use the same final safety rules. No training. Higher comfort/reward and lower energy/unsafe steps are better. Results describe this simulator and these scenarios, not measured real-world savings.
